sources.title: Methodology to assess methane leakage from anaerobic digestion plants
sources.guard: Treat measurement methodology and study results as method evidence; require site-specific measured methane, uncertainty, period and geometry before parcel claims.

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring, reporting and verification period for waste incineration
sources.guard: Treat voluntary MRV scope, templates and preliminary factors as reporting-framework evidence, not verified parcel emissions.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: quality assurance of continuous monitoring
sources.guard: Treat QAL, calibration and CEMS quality-assurance rules as measurement-quality evidence, not the measured value.

sources.title: Using UK greenhouse gas inventory data in UK ETS monitoring and reporting: country-specific factor list
sources.guard: Treat 2026 carbon factors and calorific values as calculation inputs; require compatible activity data, period, installation scope and verified spatial binding.

sources.title: Landfill operators: close your landfill site
sources.guard: Closure and aftercare monitoring requirements do not establish current methane mass or parcel attribution without actual results.

sources.title: Consultation opens on Drax Power permit draft decision
sources.guard: A permit consultation, risk assessment or carbon-capture proposal is regulatory evidence only and must not be promoted to observed emissions.

sources.title: Environment Agency Methane Action Plan 2024 to 2026
sources.guard: Policy priorities and descriptions of fugitive methane sources are not site-specific measured emissions.

sources.title: Monitoring stack emissions: guidance for selecting a monitoring approach
sources.guard: Monitoring strategy, sampling design, uncertainty and reporting requirements must remain distinct from validated concentration or mass results.

sources.title: Oil and gas: offshore environmental legislation
sources.guard: Offshore monitoring rules, templates and derogation procedures are regulatory controls, not measured emissions for an onshore cadastral parcel.

sources.title: Oil and gas: environmental alerts and incident reporting
sources.guard: Incident-reporting requirements and non-compliance notifications do not quantify total emissions unless a validated measured amount is explicitly reported.

sources.title: Environmental permitting: air dispersion modelling reports
sources.guard: Dispersion-model inputs and predicted concentrations are modelled impact evidence, not observed stack or parcel emissions.

sources.title: Risk assessments for your environmental permit
sources.guard: Risk screening and significance conclusions are permitting evidence, not direct measurements.

sources.title: Operator monitoring assessment: environmental permits
sources.guard: OMA assesses monitoring quality and reliability; it does not itself provide the emissions measurement.

sources.title: Operator monitoring assessment: environmental permits detailed guidance
sources.guard: Accreditation, calibration, audit and procedure evidence must not substitute for actual validated monitoring results.

sources.title: Environmental permitting guidance: waste incineration
sources.guard: Permit scope, BAT and IED requirements for incineration are regulatory conditions, not annual measured GHG.

sources.title: Review of best available techniques for new waste incineration issues
sources.guard: Historical BAT research and technical options are not current observed emissions and must retain publication-vintage context.

sources.title: Veolia ES Shropshire: environmental permit issued
sources.guard: An issued permit and decision document identify regulated conditions and installation context; measured parcel emissions require separate monitoring evidence.

sources.title: Part B activities: combustion and incineration permits
sources.guard: Process guidance notes and permit conditions describe BAT and regulatory scope, not observed emissions.

sources.title: Onshore oil and gas sector guidance: flares
sources.guard: Flare purpose, permitting classification and BAT design must not be converted into emission mass without measured or properly calculated activity data.

sources.title: Decarbonisation Readiness guidance consultation
sources.guard: Consultation material is draft policy evidence and must not be treated as final permit requirements or measured emissions.

sources.title: Standard rules consultation: decarbonisation readiness and carbon capture at anaerobic digestion facilities
sources.guard: Consulted standard-rule changes are proposal-stage evidence; no emissions value may be inferred from the consultation.

sources.title: Post-combustion carbon dioxide capture: emerging techniques
sources.guard: BAT, BAT-AEL and temporary derogation evidence must remain separate from captured, stored or emitted CO2 measurements.

sources.title: Oil and gas: environmental submissions and determinations
sources.guard: Registers, applications, determinations and derogation notices identify regulatory status, not measured emission magnitude.

sources.title: Guidance published on new carbon capture technologies
sources.guard: A policy/news announcement about carbon-capture guidance is contextual evidence only, not a facility measurement or parcel value.
